\ close_over_overlaps: a shown mover that overlaps one coming off or going on, drawn before it
\ (decision 37: below it, in the order movers are drawn), comes off and goes back on too, so
\ overlapping movers are always drawn in slot order and taken off in reverse (a mover's save block
\ holds what was under it, earlier movers included; one drawn after it, over it, holds its bytes in
\ its own save, so it can come off and go back on alone). Over a
\ short list of the slots that matter: each one shown or going on, with a rectangle covering
\ where it is shown and where it goes, a column and two rows to spare.
.close_over_overlaps
{
    STZ list_n
    LDY #0
.gather
    CPY act_n
    BEQ gathered
    STY ren_k
    LDX act,Y
    STX ren_i
    TXA                             \ C = 0: CPY act_n found Y < act_n
    ADC boff
    TAY
    LDA rec_xh,Y
    CMP #&FF
    BNE shown
    LDA need,X
    AND #&40
    BNE going_on
    LDY ren_k                       \ not listed: the loop's tail, kept in gather's page
    INY
    BRA gather                      \ 65C02 opcode
.going_on
    JSR list_live                   \ going on, not shown: where it goes
    BRA listed                      \ 65C02 opcode
.shown
    JSR list_recorded               \ where it is shown...
    LDX ren_i
    BIT need,X                      \ 65C02 opcode: V = need bit 6
    BVC listed
candidates.new:
.next
    LDY ren_k
    INY
    CPY act_n                       \ each's test again, here (Y <= act_n: C is clear in the body when Y < act_n)
    BNE each + 4                    \ the body, past each's CPY act_n and BEQ done (zero page: 2 + 2 bytes)
.done
    RTS
    ASSERT act_n < &100             \ so CPY act_n is 2 bytes and each + 4 is the body
}

\ close_over_overlaps: a shown mover that overlaps one coming off or going on, drawn before it
\ (decision 37: below it, in the order movers are drawn), comes off and goes back on too, so
\ overlapping movers are always drawn in slot order and taken off in reverse (a mover's save block
\ holds what was under it, earlier movers included; one drawn after it, over it, holds its bytes in
\ its own save, so it can come off and go back on alone). Over a
\ short list of the slots that matter: each one shown or going on, with a rectangle covering
\ where it is shown and where it goes, a column and two rows to spare.
.close_over_overlaps
{
    STZ list_n
    LDY #0
.gather
    CPY act_n
    BEQ gathered
.gbody_ab
    STY ren_k
    LDX act,Y
    TXA                             \ C = 0: CPY act_n found Y < act_n
    ADC boff
    TAY
    LDA rec_xh,Y
    CMP #&FF
    BNE shown
    BIT need,X                      \ 65C02 opcode: V = need bit 6 (X = slot still)
    BVS going_on
    LDY ren_k                       \ not listed: the loop's tail, with the loop's test (Y < act_n: C clear)
    INY
    CPY act_n
    BNE gbody_ab
    BRA gathered                    \ 65C02 opcode
.going_on
    STX ren_i                       \ ren_i is read only from here on: list_live's
    JSR list_live                   \ going on, not shown: where it goes
    BRA listed                      \ 65C02 opcode
.shown
    STX ren_i                       \ list_recorded's caller's X, and what widen_by_live reads
    JSR list_recorded               \ where it is shown...
    LDX ren_i
    BIT need,X                      \ 65C02 opcode: V = need bit 6
    BVC listed
candidates.summary: Both loops tested at their tails (rotated): mark_to_draw's .next does INY / CPY act_n / BNE each + 4 (the body past each's CPY act_n; BEQ done), falling into .done; close_over_overlaps' hot not-listed tail does the same (BNE gbody_ab, BRA gathered at the end); the going-on test is BIT need,X / BVS; STX ren_i moves into going_on and shown, where it is read. Alternative to A and B (it is both); measured on the bench build 2026-10-22: render -45 cycles a pass seed 1, -53 holding RIGHT (render 23430->23385, 28406->28353; logic 9440->9440 / 10255->10254).
candidates.equivalence: Every path: close_over_overlaps' gather loop is unchanged in what it lists. The going-on test: LDA need,X / AND #&40 / BNE going_on becomes BIT need,X / BVS going_on (BIT zp,X copies bit 6 to V; same Z-on-bit-6 decision, X unchanged, C unchanged; A, Z and N after it are dead: going_on's list_live and the loop tail never read A or flags, list_live's first use of every register is a load, and the tail's CPY/CMP sets its own flags). STX ren_i moves from the loop head to the only two places ren_i is read: going_on (list_live reads it with LDY ren_i; X = slot there since BIT/BNE leave X alone) and shown (list_recorded takes X = slot, widen_by_live reads ren_i via list_live, LDX ren_i after the call). grep of src/ shows ren_i is read only in render.6502 at mark_to_draw's/classify's own stores (set before every read) and in list_live; nothing reads the value ren_i leaves after close_over_overlaps. mark_to_draw's rotation: the body is entered from the tail only when CPY act_n found Y != act_n; Y starts 0 and steps by 1 so Y < act_n and C is clear for the body's ADC boff, exactly as when each's CPY act_n / BEQ done fell through (that CPY now runs once, for the first entry). Falling off the tail when Y = act_n reaches .done RTS with Y = act_n, Z = C = 1, as BEQ done did. each + 4 is the body: CPY act_n (zero page) 2 bytes + BEQ done 2 bytes, ASSERTed via act_n < &100 and checked in the listing (BNE C5 from &97D8 = &979D = STY ren_k). In close_over_overlaps the tail's BNE gbody_ab is taken only with Y < act_n (C clear for ADC boff); when Y = act_n it BRAs to gathered with Y = act_n, Z = C = 1 as before (gathered/again load nothing live). The other tail (.not_listed after .listed, outside the window) still BRAs to gather, whose CPY act_n / BEQ gathered is kept. Verified by passlock seed 1 and 3 (3000 passes, state and screen identical), helilock 5 and 2 (0 frames differ), and all of ship, gameplay, DEBUG_FULLREDRAW+DEBUG_LIVES and SKY_HELI=0 build.
candidates.relies_on: mark_to_draw's body stays at each + 4 (act_n in zero page, ASSERTed). New label gbody_ab is unique to this candidate. Code grows 6 bytes (mark_to_draw +2, close_over_overlaps +4): every label after slides 6 bytes; checked in the bench listing: the new loop (&97E1-&97FA) and mark_to_draw's loop stay inside page &97, BNE shown still crosses &97/&98 as it did (taken 2.5 a pass, was crossing before); the .listed tail's BRA gather still crosses back as before; no hot branch after the window newly crosses a page in the bench build (measured -45/-53, the gate decides). BNE shown/BRA gathered are the same lengths as before. A, B and AL below are parts of or alternatives to this.
